nodes.name: Catalog size response
nodes.description: CatalogSizeResponse payload containing the product count.

nodes.name: Product response
nodes.description: model.Product payload returned in JSON by the product list, product detail and search routes.

nodes.name: Product document
nodes.description: ProductDocument (and equivalent ProductData) with string tag names, used to write the search index and as the seed for SQL products.

nodes.name: Parsed product query
nodes.description: Argument tuple tags []string, order, page and size passed from the controller through CatalogAPI to the repository.

nodes.name: Parsed tag filter for count
nodes.description: Tag-name slice passed to CountProducts after splitting the CSV query parameter.

nodes.name: Tag list response
nodes.description: JSON array of model.Tag returned by GET /catalog/tags.

nodes.name: Tag seed entity
nodes.description: model.Tag value created from embedded ProductTagData before it is saved.

nodes.name: GET /catalog/size
nodes.description: Gin route handled by Controller.CatalogSize; returns the product count, optionally filtered by tags.

nodes.name: GET /catalog/products/:id
nodes.description: Gin route handled by Controller.GetProduct; looks up one product by its path id.

nodes.name: GET /catalog/products
nodes.description: Gin route handled by Controller.GetProducts; parses catalog filters and returns a JSON product list.

nodes.name: GET /catalog/tags
nodes.description: Gin route handled by Controller.ListTags; returns all catalog tags as JSON.

nodes.name: POST /catalog/reindex
nodes.description: Gin route handled by Controller.ReindexProducts; recreates the OpenSearch product index from embedded data.

nodes.name: GET /catalog/search
nodes.description: Gin route handled by Controller.SearchProducts; searches the OpenSearch product index by keyword.

nodes.name: Service startup (main)
nodes.description: main() constructs the catalog repository, which seeds the SQL store from embedded JSON, and initializes the OpenSearch index when search is enabled.

nodes.name: Count catalog products
nodes.description: Count products with an optional tag-name filter and wrap the result in CatalogSizeResponse.

nodes.name: Get product by id
nodes.description: Pass the id path parameter to the repository, preload tags and return the single product as JSON.

nodes.name: List catalog products
nodes.description: Parse tags/order/page/size, query products with tag joins, ordering and pagination, and return model.Product values as JSON.

nodes.name: List catalog tags
nodes.description: Read tags from the SQL store ordered by displayName and return them as a JSON array.

nodes.name: Reindex product search data
nodes.description: Require search to be enabled, delete the existing product index and repopulate it from embedded product data.

nodes.name: Search catalog products
nodes.description: Require search to be enabled and a non-empty keyword, query OpenSearch with fuzziness and pagination, then map hits to model.Product.

nodes.name: Seed catalog stores at startup
nodes.description: Load embedded JSON tags and products, normalize them, and populate the SQL catalog tables and (when search is enabled) the OpenSearch index.

nodes.name: Embedded products.json contents
nodes.description: Product records embedded at compile time by go:embed and decoded by LoadProductData.

nodes.name: Embedded tags.json contents
nodes.description: Tag records embedded at compile time by go:embed and decoded by LoadProductTagData.

nodes.name: GET /catalog/products query parameters
nodes.description: tags, order, page and size query parameters of the product-list request.

nodes.name: Product id path parameter
nodes.description: Required id path parameter of GET /catalog/products/{id}.

nodes.name: GET /catalog/search query parameters
nodes.description: keyword, page and size query parameters of the catalog search request.

nodes.name: GET /catalog/size query parameters
nodes.description: tags query parameter used to filter the product count.

nodes.name: Skip index initialization when populated
nodes.description: Startup OpenSearch initialization skips index creation when the index already exists and contains documents.

nodes.name: Integer query validation
nodes.description: page and size must parse as integers through getQueryInt; otherwise the handler returns HTTP 400.

nodes.name: Search keyword required
nodes.description: GET /catalog/search rejects an empty keyword query parameter with HTTP 400.

nodes.name: Pagination defaults and limit
nodes.description: page defaults to 1 and size to 10; SQL applies OFFSET=(page-1)*size with LIMIT size and OpenSearch applies from=(page-1)*size with size.

nodes.name: Search feature gate
nodes.description: Search and reindex require a configured OpenSearch SearchRepository; otherwise the routes return HTTP 503 (search is disabled by default).

nodes.name: Catalog products table
nodes.description: GORM products table with a many2many product_tags join to tags; backed by in-memory SQLite by default or MySQL when configured.

nodes.name: Catalog tags table
nodes.description: GORM tags table seeded from embedded tags.json and read by GET /catalog/tags.

nodes.name: OpenSearch product index
nodes.description: OpenSearch index of product documents with keyword/text mappings on name, description and tags.

edges.note: After deleting the old index, documents are bulk indexed with refresh=true from the embedded product data.
ProductDocument fields are marshalled as bulk index action/source documents when search is enabled.
Each tag entity is saved into the tags table.
LoadProductData output is copied field-for-field into ProductDocument values for the new index.
Decoded ProductData is mapped field-for-field into ProductDocument (string tag names).
Embedded ProductTagData values are copied into model.Tag with the same name/displayName shape.
The single model.Product row is returned unchanged as the JSON response.
GORM Find returns []model.Product with Preload('Tags'), which is serialized unchanged by ctx.JSON.
GORM returns []model.Tag ordered by display_name, serialized unchanged as JSON.
Tag-name strings are resolved through tagMap into []model.Tag before db.Create writes the product row.
tags become JOIN/WHERE tags.name IN (...), order becomes ORDER BY, page/size become OFFSET/LIMIT on the GORM query.
Tag names filter products through the product_tags and tags joins before COUNT.
Comma-separated tags split into []string; page/size query text parsed to int with defaults 1/10; order kept as string.
Path id is used in WHERE id = ? with Preload('Tags') and First.
keyword becomes a multi_match query over name^2/description/tags with fuzziness AUTO; page/size become from=(page-1)*size and size.
Comma-separated tags query parameter is split into a []string tag filter.
COUNT result is cast to int and wrapped as CatalogSizeResponse.Size.
SearchResponse hits._source documents map to model.Product; tag strings become Tag{Name} with no displayName.
